title: 第68章 家家有本难念的经

第68章 家家有本难念的经-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

夕阳西斜的时候，林国强一家四口骑车回家。

赵素梅忽然说：“国强，今天谢谢你。”

“谢啥？”

“谢谢你给我长脸。”她声音轻轻的，“以前回娘家，姐姐们说话，我都不敢吭声，现在我敢了。”

林国强腾出一只手，握住她的手。

“以后你想说啥就说啥。

天塌了，我给你顶着。”

赵素梅没说话。

手却握紧了。

夜里，孙建民家。

赵素芳躺在炕上，翻来覆去睡不着。

“建民。”

“嗯？”

“你说，国强那个店，真那么挣钱？”

孙建民翻了个身：“我哪知道。”

“志军一个月四十块。”

赵素芳坐起来，“你一个月才三十八块五，你干了多少年了？他才干几个月？”

孙建民不说话了。

“你说……咱也干个体户咋样？”

“你疯了？”孙建民也坐起来，“我铁饭碗，你让我去干个体户？”

“可国强挣钱多啊。”

“挣钱多咋了？不稳定！”

孙建民语气不好，“今天有明天没的，我这铁饭碗，一辈子不愁。”

赵素芳不说话了。

但心里那个念头，像种子一样，埋下了。

同一时刻，刘胜利家。

刘胜利躺在炕上，也睡不着。

他在供销社干了快十年了，工资从二十几块涨到四十几块，以为自己过得不错了。

可林国强一个个体户，几个月就起来了。

小舅子跟着他干，一个月四十块。

再过两年呢？

他忽然觉得，自己那个铁饭碗，好像也没那么铁了。

刘强家住在镇子东头，三间青砖瓦房，院墙刷了白灰。

刘强说要请林国强吃顿家常饭，林国强把店里交给赵志军管，提前过来了。

他提着两斤卤肉、一兜水果进门的时候，刘强正在院子里劈柴。

“来就来，带啥东西。”

刘强放下斧头，拍了拍手上的木屑。

“自己店里的卤味，让你尝尝。”林国强把东西递过去。

刘强接过来，闻了闻，笑了：“你这卤味绝了，镇上现在最火的就是你家这一口。”

“捧场。”

As the sun set, Lin Guoqiang's family of four rode home.

Zhao Sumei suddenly said: "Guoqiang, thank you today."

"Thank you for what?"

"Thank you for giving me face." She said softly, "I used to dare not say a word when my sisters talked when I went back to my parents' home, but now I dare."

Lin Guoqiang freed up a hand and held her hand.

“You can say whatever you want from now on.

If the sky falls, I will support you."

Zhao Sumei said nothing.

But his hands were clenched.

At night, Sun Jianmin's house.

Zhao Sufang lay on the kang, tossing and turning, unable to sleep.

"Jianmin."

"Huh?"

"You said, is Guoqiang's store really that profitable?"

Sun Jianmin turned over and said, "I didn't know."

"Zhijun earns forty yuan a month."

Zhao Sufang sat up and said, "You only earn 38.5 yuan a month. How many years have you been working? How many months has he been working?"

Sun Jianmin stopped talking.

"What do you think...how about we also become self-employed?"

"Are you crazy?" Sun Jianmin also sat up, "I have a guaranteed job, and you want me to become a self-employed person?"

"But Guoqiang makes a lot of money."

"What's wrong with making so much money? It's not stable!"

Sun Jianmin said in a bad tone, "I will have nothing to worry about today, but I will never have to worry about my iron rice bowl for the rest of my life."

Zhao Sufang stopped talking.

But the thought in my heart was planted like a seed.

At the same moment, Liu Shengli came home.

Liu Shengli lay on the kang, unable to sleep.

He has been working in the supply and marketing cooperative for almost ten years, and his salary has increased from more than 20 yuan to more than 40 yuan. He thinks he is living a good life.

But Lin Guoqiang is a self-employed person who started working in just a few months.

My brother-in-law works with him for forty yuan a month.

What about two more years?

He suddenly felt that his iron rice bowl didn't seem so iron-clad anymore.

Liu Qiang's family lives in the east end of the town. They have three blue brick houses with whitewashed courtyard walls.

Liu Qiang said he wanted to treat Lin Guoqiang to a home-cooked meal. Lin Guoqiang handed over the store to Zhao Zhijun and came over in advance.

When he came in carrying two kilograms of braised pork and a bag of fruits, Liu Qiang was chopping firewood in the yard.

"Come here and bring whatever you need."

Liu Qiang put down the ax and patted the sawdust on his hand.

"Let you try the braised food in my store." Lin Guoqiang handed the stuff over.

Liu Qiang took it, smelled it, and smiled: "Your braised food is amazing. Your food is the most popular in town right now."

"Support."
